summary: Selects output pixel resolution independently of aspect ratio. Veo 3.1 and Veo 3.1 Fast support 720p, 1080p, and 4k; Veo 3.1 Lite supports 720p and 1080p only.
combines: 1080p and 4k require durationSeconds=8, which the provider enforces before submission.
Video extension is restricted to 720p and the provider normalizes extension requests accordingly.
Higher resolution increases processing time and output size; 4k is not available on Lite.

usage.from: state.videoResolution, validated from the selected Veo model's Resolution control
usage.what: Sends only synchronized model resolutions and normalizes extension requests to 720p.
